title: FUYAO: DPU-enabled Direct Data Transfer for Serverless Computing
problem: Serverless computing relies on third-party forwarding for data transfer between functions, coupling control and data flow together and resulting in slow data transmission speeds. This makes meeting low-latency requirements for web services difficult.
motivation: Low-latency data transmission between functions is critical for serverless computing to support modern web service requirements.
method: FUYAO uses Data Processing Units (DPUs) as programmable hardware to enable direct data transfer between serverless functions. The system decouples control flow from data flow by offloading data movement to DPU hardware, bypassing traditional third-party forwarding methods.
key_novelty: Using DPU hardware to enable direct decoupled data transfer between serverless functions without third-party forwarding.
contributions: DPU-based direct data transfer mechanism for serverless inter-function communication
Decoupling of control and data flow in serverless architecture
Low-latency data transmission system for serverless computing
Hardware-software co-design for efficient serverless data movement
primary_theme: DPU-based direct data transfer for serverless computing
